# Support Resources for EQ12 GODSTACK

## Getting Help

If you need assistance with EQ12 GODSTACK, here are the available support channels:

### 🏛️ Governance & Compliance Support

- **GitHub Discussions**: [Governance & Compliance Category](https://github.com/Vibehigheric/EQ12/discussions/categories/governance-compliance)
  - Ask questions about PR processes, CODEOWNERS, governance gates
  - Get clarification on compliance requirements
  - Discuss process improvements

- **Direct Contact**: compliance@eq12-godstack.local
  - For urgent compliance matters
  - Sensitive business stack issues (Betting/Cannabis/Credit)
  - Escalation of governance violations

### 🔒 Security & Technical Support

- **GitHub Discussions**: [Security & Secrets Category](https://github.com/Vibehigheric/EQ12/discussions/categories/security-secrets)
  - Security best practices discussion
  - Authentication and access control questions
  - Workflow security concerns

- **Issue Templates**: Use our structured issue templates
  - [🚨 Governance Violation Report](/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/governance_violation.yml)
  - [🔒 Security Incident Report](/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/security_incident.yml)
  - [💡 Governance Improvement Request](/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/governance_improvement.yml)

### ⚙️ CI/CD & Workflow Support

- **GitHub Discussions**: [CI/CD & Actions Category](https://github.com/Vibehigheric/EQ12/discussions/categories/ci-cd-actions)
  - GitHub Actions troubleshooting
  - Deployment and workflow questions
  - Pipeline optimization discussions

### 📋 Audit & Review Support

- **GitHub Discussions**: [Audits & Reviews Category](https://github.com/Vibehigheric/EQ12/discussions/categories/audits-reviews)
  - Quarterly compliance audit participation
  - Process documentation discussions
  - Regulatory requirement clarifications

## Business Stack Specific Support

### 🎰 Betting Stack
- **Compliance Requirements**: Gambling regulations, responsible gaming
- **Escalation**: Immediate review required for all changes
- **Contact**: compliance@eq12-godstack.local

### 🌿 Cannabis Stack  
- **Compliance Requirements**: METRC integration, state regulations
- **Escalation**: State authority notification may be required
- **Contact**: compliance@eq12-godstack.local

### 💳 Credit Stack
- **Compliance Requirements**: PCI DSS, financial regulations
- **Escalation**: Financial authority reporting may be required
- **Contact**: compliance@eq12-godstack.local

## Self-Service Resources

### 🔍 Before Asking for Help
1. **Search Discussions**: Check if your question has been answered
2. **Review Documentation**: Consult relevant guides and policies
3. **Check Issue Templates**: Use structured forms for reporting
4. **Review Workflow Logs**: Check GitHub Actions for error details

### 🛠️ Common Solutions
- **PR Template Issues**: Use the correct template for your change type
- **CODEOWNERS Failures**: Ensure required approvers are added
- **Security Gate Failures**: Check for secrets, vulnerabilities, or policy violations
- **Workflow Failures**: Review logs and ensure all requirements are met

### 📊 Monitoring & Status
- **GitHub Projects Board**: Track governance issues and improvements
- **Workflow Status**: Monitor CI/CD pipeline health
- **Compliance Dashboard**: Review quarterly audit status

## Response Times

| Issue Type | Response Time | Resolution Time |
|------------|---------------|-----------------|
| Critical Security | 2 hours | 24 hours |
| Governance Violation | 4 hours | 48 hours |
| Sensitive Stack Issue | 1 hour | 12 hours |
| General Support | 24 hours | 5 business days |
| Process Questions | 24 hours | 3 business days |
